header.title: You asked how to read it. Here’s the one-screen version.
header.sub: One timeline, one read: what I believed before, the line that moved it, what I believed after. Built in your one-table shape, one small form repeated down the page, nothing to install or decode.

blocks.h2: One row at a time. A belief, the line that moved it, the updated belief.
blocks.quote: we standardize all of data into a single table and use that table to answer all the questions
blocks.attr: You, Jul 22. So this is one shape, repeated: a belief, the line that moved it, the update, the same at a single row or the whole call. One table, the way yours answers everything at any zoom. No topography, no layers to peel.

blocks.h2: The bet I got wrong: I thought you were the customer.
blocks.intro: Before we talked I bet the first move was running this on Polyform’s own data. You corrected me in one line.

beats.before: Run ARCS on Polyform’s data, you’re the user.
beats.quote: I think our data is less interesting, but our customers’ need is probably way more interesting
beats.after: You’re not the user, you’re the channel. And you’d already described the whole loop back to me, so there was never a concept to sell.

blocks.caption: Scoring my own read, not yours. The receipt grades the person who filed the bet.

blocks.h2: The thing that helps this month, and the thing for later.

cards.h3: Now: your new rep’s first meetings
cards.p: You said he started two weeks ago with no meetings yet. The quick, useful taste is pressure-testing the ICP and the pre-meeting questions, so his first real calls go in sharp. Small, this week if you want it.

cards.h3: Later: the run-once channel you sketched
cards.p: When your customers have the call volume, the sponsored run-once-per-company idea you floated is the real one. It’s yours, I kept it warm. No pilot fee to discuss until it’s actually useful to you.
Nothing here is aspirational, and nothing here needs access to your systems. If a capability is roadmap, I’ll mark it as roadmap.

blocks.h2: That’s the whole read. No format to pick, nothing owed.
blocks.intro: You asked what format would be easiest. This is me just building it, so there’s nothing on your side to answer.

needs.h3: If the rep angle is useful
needs.p: Say the word and I’ll turn the ICP pressure-test around fast, one page, no lift on your end.
Back on my feet soon, coffee when I’m in the city. Those pay dividends, your words.

blocks.close: Good to be circling the same problem from two sides, you from the data, me from the decision.

foot: ARCS · ONE SHAPE, ANY SCALE · KEEP EACH OTHER AWARE
